title: Ines and the Echo Anew
author: Mara Villalobos
blurb: Xanthe Villalobos, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
